description: Deep background memory search (query + search_as statement forms, both in the memory base_language) when turn/memory_search found nothing reliable: on-server agent collects ranked evidence (~10-30 s, ~0.1 RUB). Returns job_id; poll memory_recall_status(job_id).

query.description: The question in the memory base_language (turn/step_zero report base_language); keep names and exact terms.

search_as.description: Optional, recommended: the same up to 3 statement forms you passed to turn/memory_search (how the answer was most likely WRITTEN in memory, base_language, keep names, never invent the unknown fact). Used as an extra seed of the deep search.

name: memory_recall_later
